title: [CRY-21] Device enrollment has no proof of possession of the new key
description: Review finding CRY-21: Device enrollment has no proof of possession of the new key (lens CRY). Location: spec/02-identity.md:336. Fix: 02:336 says the request "is signed per §13.1.1 by an existing registered device key. For first-device enrollment the envelope `sig` is absent". The new key never signs, so a holder of an IdP token can register any public key, including one that belongs to someone else. The impact is limited to duplicate-key and unknown-key-share confusion, because the registrant cannot sign with the key, hence P3. Add a self-signature by the new key over the request, bound to the IdP token nonce. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
